description: Place an order for an item a verified business publishes (see list_business_offerings). The order goes straight to the business, where it already works: email, its own store or its own system. Returns a reference and a status URL. When the business connected a payment account (Stripe, PayPal, Mollie, Razorpay, Lemon Squeezy or Paddle), the answer carries a pay_url on that account; the money goes to the business, never to Orbylon. For an appointment, the answer can carry a book_url where the buyer chooses the time on the business's own booking page.

fulfilment.description: How the buyer receives it, and how the business reaches them

idempotency_key.description: Send the same key when retrying

item.description: The item name exactly as listed

item_id.description: The item id from the catalogue
